description.zh: 连接后可查询公众号客户信息，用于客户语义匹配和筛选条件核验。未连接时，客户匹配与筛选能力不可用。
description.en: Connect to query the WeChat customer directory for customer matching and filter validation. Customer matching and filtering are unavailable until connected.

title.zh: 配置公众号客户信息表访问令牌

description.zh: 请输入可调用 query_wx_cust_db 的访问令牌。
description.en: Enter an access token that can invoke query_wx_cust_db.

description.zh: 令牌仅用于连接公众号客户信息表，不会被打包进专家包。
description.en: The token is used only to connect to the WeChat customer directory and is never packaged with the expert.
